subject.title: feat(chat-ui): inline diffs for edit and write tool rows

question: Should this follow-up complete conservative parity for cached history and all established edit-tool families before merge, or should its initial scope be narrowed to authoritative live `details.diff` results only?
rationale: Both paths can be coherent, but the choice determines whether the shared Apple UI promises broad web parity or a deliberately limited first implementation; the protected maintainer label requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Complete conservative parity
options.body: Preserve bounded diff inputs through cache, carry terminal outcome, support apply-patch, and avoid unproven overwrite/no-op statistics before merging.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Render only recognized successful tool results with authoritative `details.diff`, and defer argument-derived and cache-derived previews to a separately scoped follow-up.

recommendation.title: Complete conservative parity
recommendation.body: Preserve bounded diff inputs through cache, carry terminal outcome, support apply-patch, and avoid unproven overwrite/no-op statistics before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current shared tool-row architecture and authored both the merged substrate and this direct follow-up.
